name: lastpuff-functions
description: LastPuff Cloud Functions — AI coach, moderation, entitlements, crons.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cirrus "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-cirrus "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts"
